rationale: David brings deep expertise shipping autonomous systems (drones, tractors, robots) and building real-time infrastructure, while Shirley is actively building AI and developer-tool projects with a strong TypeScript/Python stack. intro_message: David Chen, meet Shirley Li — David's spent a decade shipping autonomous systems and knows the real-time infrastructure gap in robotics, and Shirley's an ML researcher building AI tools with TypeScript chops, so you two could explore how to tackle observability or edge compute for robotics projects.
